segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: Right... let s try and get it sorted out today so we don t have it hanging over us. OK?

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: Good idea. I’ll take notes.

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: First thing .. . numbers... have we got anything definite?

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: Well.. . I’ve been working it out and I think 40 to 43.

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: Shall we put 45 to be on the safe side?

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: Yep, fine.

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: Dates ... well. That’s straightforward.

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: The last working day before Christmas ... which is...

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: . .. which is December the 21st.

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: .. . which is going to be pretty difficult to book at Christmas so we’d better think of two or three places just to be on the safe side.

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: Well, last year’s was hopeless.

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: The Red Lion, wasn’t it?

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: Yep. We ought to go for something more expensive, cos you . ..

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: . .. you gets what you pay for.

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: That new Indian restaurant in Wetherfield is supposed to be excellent... the Rajdoot.

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: How do you spell that?

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: R-A-J-D-O-O-T.

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: But it’s bound to be packed.

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: Well, let’s put that down as the first choice and have some back-ups. What about the Park View Hotel as a second choice?

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: Yes, that’s always reliable. Park View Hotel. ..

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: And the London Arms in case.

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: London Arms . ..

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: I’ll call them now if you want.

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: No. I’ll do it, Joan. You’re really busy. Have you got the numbers?

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: Not for the Rajdoot, but... right... Park View Hotel: 777192 and ... London Arms: 208657.

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: Great. Before I ring, we’d better just make sure they’re within the price range.

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: Up to £15 a head?

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: I think you’ll find some people won’t be able to go that high.

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: Well, you can’t get anything decent under £10.

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: OK. We’ll say £12?

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: OK.

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: And we’d better make sure there’s good vegetarian food.

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: And a non-smoking section! You know what the boss is like.

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: Good news. 1 found Rajdoot’s number straight away and they can fit us in. Their Christmas menu sounds great.

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: What is it?

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: French onion soup or fruit juice.

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: Uh-huh.

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: Roast dinner or lentil curry .. . sounds ordinary but my friend said it was really tasty.

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: Umm ... lentil curry ... that’s unusual.

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: Then for dessert there’s traditional plum pudding or apple pie, plus coffee.

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: That sounds really good for £12. Did you book it?

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: Well, I said I’d check with the staff first. But they did say they’d hold the booking until next Wednesday anyway. Oh, and if we go ahead, they’d like a £50 deposit.

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: 50 is normal. .. that’s fine.

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: And they want a letter.

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: Right... to confirm.

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: And they say with such large numbers we have to choose the menu in advance.

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: That won’t be a problem. I’ll put up a notice with details of the restaurant and the menu. When did you say they wanted confirmation by?

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: It was .. . let’s see . .. the 4th of November.

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: Where do you think I should put up the notice? Where everyone’s guaranteed to see it.

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: On the cafe noticeboard I should think.

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: Hardly anyone looks at that.

segments.speaker: PETER
segments.en: Well, the Newsletter is probably your best bet.

segments.speaker: JOAN
segments.en: Good idea. I’ll go and do that now.
